editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood taco spot where owner Jose greets you warmly and the fresh, expertly-prepared Mexican food rivals the best in the city.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive ready to sample their rotating aguas frescas (try the passion fruit and limeade mix) — the owner offers generous tastings at the door, and don't skip the quesabirrias, which come with rich consomé for dipping.
